newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Co plans Uzbekistan gold mine venture-paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Co plans Uzbekistan gold mine venture-paper.

text.p: Leading Japanese trading company Mitsui & Co Ltd plans to set up a joint venture to start feasibility studies to develop four gold mines in Uzbekistan, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.

After the study is completed, the joint venture with Newmont Gold Co NGC N of the United States and Uzbekistan's state committee for geology is expected to start mining gold ore in late 1999 or early 2000, the Japanese daily Nikkei Shimbun reported.

The four gold mines are located about 100 km south of the capital city of Tashkent. The total gold deposits are estimated at 240 tonnes, worth some $3 billion at current prices, it said. The mining project is forecast to prouce about 10 tonnes of gold a year, worth $120 million, it said.
Newmont and Mitsui's combined shares in the joint venture are likely to exceed 50 percent, although details of the project owndership have not been disclosed, the paper said.
